rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides a persistent memory layer that survives session boundaries and accumulates knowledge over time. Multiple agents can read and write to the same memory pool with optional agent attribution for filtered retrieval. Supports native installation on macOS and Linux, Docker on all platforms, and includes tools for memory storage, inference, file import, git history capture, and project state tracking. Data stays local with AES-256 encryption at rest.
